Dsky is an advanced security tool that encrypts and protects your DNS traffic.

 What is DNS and DoH?
 Whenever you open a website, its domain name is translated into an IP address. Normally, this process is unencrypted and can be monitored by your internet provider. With DNS over HTTPS (DoH), Dsky routes all DNS requests through a fully encrypted and secure tunnel, preventing eavesdropping and tracking. 

 App Management & Filtering (Split Tunneling): 
 By default, traffic from all apps on your device is secured and routed through DoH. However, by tapping the Settings (slider) icon at the top of the screen, you can exclude specific apps: 

 • Fix compatibility issues: Some banking apps, financial services, or ride-hailing apps may not work properly with custom DNS servers. By selecting them from the list, they will use your device's default internet connection directly without interruption. 

 • Optimize speed and latency: You can exclude non-sensitive apps or games from the secure tunnel to reduce network overhead and improve performance.
If you have any questions, suggestions, or bug reports, you can contact the developer via email.
